entries.title: Job 4:1
segments: And Eliphaz the Temanite answered:

entries.title: Job 4:2
segments: Shall one try a word with you, you [who] are weary? But who can hold back with words?

entries.title: Job 4:3
segments: Behold, you have instructed many, and you have made the weak hands strong.

entries.title: Job 4:4
segments: Your words have upheld him who was falling, and you have made strong the feeble knees.

entries.title: Job 4:5
segments: But now it has come upon you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

entries.title: Job 4:6
segments: [Is] not your reverence your hope? Is not your hope the uprightness of your ways?

entries.title: Job 4:7
segments: Remember, please, who [ever] perished, being innocent? Or where were the righteous cut off?

entries.title: Job 4:8
segments: As I have seen, the ones who plow iniquity and sow wickedness reap the same.

entries.title: Job 4:9
segments: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of His nostrils they are destroyed.

entries.title: Job 4:10
segments: The roar of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

entries.title: Job 4:11
segments: The strong lion perishes for lack of prey, and the strong lion's cubs are scattered abroad.

entries.title: Job 4:12
segments: And a word was secretly brought to me, and my ear received a little of it.

entries.title: Job 4:13
segments: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls upon men,

entries.title: Job 4:14
segments: fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

entries.title: Job 4:15
segments: And a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up.

entries.title: Job 4:16
segments: It stood still, but I could not tell the form of it. An image [was] before my eyes; silence; then I heard a voice,

entries.title: Job 4:17
segments: Shall mortal [man] be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

entries.title: Job 4:18
segments: Behold, He puts no trust in His servants, and His angels He charges with folly!

entries.title: Job 4:19
segments: How much less [in] those who live in houses of clay, whose foundation [is] in the dust, [who] are crushed before the moth?

entries.title: Job 4:20
segments: They are destroyed from morning till evening; they perish forever without anyone caring.

entries.title: Job 4:21
segments: Is not their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, but not with wisdom.
